title: The Spirit Bathhouse
subtitle: Live class · Basic math (addition and subtraction)
story: The great spirit bathhouse's biggest tub is filthy, and only bundles of magic bath herbs can clean it. Solve a sum in any room to pick up a herb bundle. Carry it to the big tub and drop it in, then go back for more until the class has filled it.

No people, no text.
